In which states do nursing homes receive the most health citations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What power level did U.S. reactors report on average across 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(power AS double)), 1) AS avg_pct_power FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2023 %'
Which conditions are studied in the most clinical trials?
SELECT condition, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE condition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many figures does a granted patent include on average?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(num_figures AS double)), 1) AS avg_figures FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_figures

SELECT state_of_incorporation, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'New' AND school_year = '2023-2024'

SELECT state, max(try_cast(total_viii_group_newly_eligible_enrollees AS double)) AS newly_eligible FROM govblock_health.medicaid_medicaid_enrollment_new_adult_group WHERE cast(enrollment_year AS varchar) = '2019' AND cast(enrollment_month AS varchar) = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In patent suits, who usually asks for a jury: plaintiffs, defendants or both?
SELECT jury_demand, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT family_id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents

In which states do the most people speak a language other than English at home?

Which states have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT try_cast(tot_pub_debt_out_amt AS double) AS total_debt FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30'

How many robocall complaints did people in Florida file with the FCC in 2021?

SELECT cat_des, sum(try_cast(dis_amo AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.candidate_disbursement WHERE cat_des IS NOT NULL AND cat_des IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'

SELECT violation_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_violations WHERE violation_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many human single-protein targets does ChEMBL list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_target_dictionary WHERE organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Which world regions post the most physics job openings on INSPIRE?
SELECT regions, count(*) AS jobs FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_jobs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many outside sources does ChEBI cite?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_source
At what hours of the day did the most fatal crashes happen in 2022?
SELECT hourname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did a typical NIH R01 research grant cost in fiscal 2024?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_cost AS double))) AS avg_total_cost FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' AND activity = 'R01' AND try_cast(total_cost AS double) > 0
Which foreign patent offices do U.S. applications most often claim priority from?
SELECT parent_country, count(*) AS claims FROM govblock_patents.patex_foreign_priority_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the name of PubChem compound 2244?
SELECT c1 AS name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title WHERE c0 = '2244'
What are New York's biggest counties by 2025 population estimate?

SELECT ctyname, try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' AND stname = 'New York' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the most solar power California's grid has delivered in a single hour?

SELECT max(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) AS peak_solar_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO'
Which countries issued the most drug warnings recorded in ChEMBL?
SELECT warning_country, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal award recipients are registered in Puerto Rico?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state = 'PR'
Among the most specific research concepts, which have the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts WHERE cast(level AS varchar) = '5' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of mortgage applications were denied for each race of applicant in 2023?

SELECT derived_race, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct_denied FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which antipsychotic drugs are prescribed most under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_clms AS double) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND antpsyct_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did New York households on full service pay per kilowatt hour in 2020, on average?

SELECT round(100 * sum(try_cast(revenues AS double)) / sum(try_cast(sales AS double)), 2) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' AND column06 = 'NY'
Which states drew the most from the Unemployment Trust Fund in 2020?

SELECT acct_desc AS state, abs(sum(try_cast(shares_per_par AS double))) AS withdrawn FROM govblock_treasury.utf_account_statement WHERE report_type = 'State' AND trans_desc_cd LIKE '21-10%' AND substr(cast(eff_date AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Apple or Samsung Electronics receive more U.S. patents in 2021?

SELECT a.disambig_assignee_organization, count(DISTINCT p.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id WHERE p.patent_date LIKE '2021%' AND a.disambig_assignee_organization IN ('Apple Inc.', 'Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which NIH institutes are credited with funding the most PubMed papers?
SELECT agency, count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_grants WHERE agency LIKE '%NIH HHS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did a winning House candidate raise on average in the 2022 cycle?
SELECT avg(ttl_receipts) AS average FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(gen_election AS varchar) = 'W' AND cand_id LIKE 'H%'
Which formal enforcement tools does EPA use most in water permit cases?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were homes worth on average when buyers took out a mortgage in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(property_value AS double))) AS avg_property_value FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) = '1'
Which reliability regions had the most units reporting to EPA in 2023?
SELECT nerc_region, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND nerc_region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many congressional districts include part of Brooklyn (Kings County)?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid_cd119_20) AS districts FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_cd11920_county20 WHERE geoid_county_20 = '36047' AND try_cast(arealand_part AS double) > 0
Which compounds go by the most synonyms in PubChem?

SELECT t.c1 AS compound, count(*) AS synonyms FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_synonym_filtered AS s JOIN govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_title AS t ON t.c0 = s.c0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug and disease pairings have reached approval?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE max_phase_for_ind = 4
Which genes or proteins are named in the most chemistry patents?

SELECT e.corrected_text AS gene_or_protein, count(DISTINCT l.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_locations AS l JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_entities AS e ON cast(e.id AS varchar) = cast(l.entity_id AS varchar) JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_biomedical_types AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(e.type_id AS varchar) WHERE t.type_name = 'GeneOrProtein' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people were hired across the U.S. economy in December 2024?
SELECT value AS hires_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000HIL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which kinds of magnetic ordering are most common among computed materials?
SELECT ordering, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the average installed price per watt of residential solar change from 2010 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) / (try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) * 1000)), 2) AS dollars_per_watt FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE customer_segment = 'RES' AND try_cast(total_installed_price AS double) > 0 AND try_cast(pv_system_size_dc AS double) > 0 AND substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the most Medicare outpatient hospital services in 2023?
Medicare Outpatient Hospitals By Geography And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(capc_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_outpatient_hospitals_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND source_file LIKE '%DY23%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of EPA enforcement cases change from fiscal 2000 to fiscal 2010?
SELECT cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) IN ('2000', '2010') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What kinds of opinion make up the archive: lead, concurring, dissenting?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, how many days of extra patent term do patents get for USPTO delays?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
What jobs do public school district staff hold, by number employed?

SELECT staff, round(sum(try_cast(staff_count AS double))) AS staff_fte FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059 WHERE school_year = (SELECT max(school_year) FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_059) AND total_indicator = 'Category Set A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of reported fund holdings are options rather than shares?
SELECT coalesce(nullif(putcall, ''), 'Shares') AS kind, count(*) AS holdings FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which recipients received the largest single grants in fiscal 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(total_obligation AS double) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'grant' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest combined rate ever paid on I bonds?
SELECT max(try_cast(combined_rate AS double)) AS highest_rate FROM govblock_treasury.i_bonds_interest_rates
In which states do Davis-Bacon determinations set the highest carpenter wages?

SELECT substr(wd_number, 1, 2) AS state, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE classification LIKE 'CARPENTER%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many lenders filed HMDA mortgage data for 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT lei) AS lenders FROM govblock_finance.hmda_ts WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023'
Which enforcement actions are taken most often against hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT enforcement_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements WHERE enforcement_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
